from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(3-mu)/4; sf=norm.sf(a); return mu+4*norm.pdf(a)/sf-7 if sf>1e-10 else 1e10
mu=brentq(eq,3.01,6.99)
assert abs(mu-4.924)<0.15
